summary: Blockchain Digital Infrastructure, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of an underwriter's over-allotment option following its June 8, 2026 public offering. Underwriter Lucid Capital Markets exercised the option in full for 4,999,999 shares at $1.65 per share less discounts, generating additional net proceeds of $7.75 million. The issuer also granted Representative Warrants for 200,000 shares at $1.815 per share exercisable through June 5, 2031. This is a routine capital markets transaction involving a shelf takedown under an existing registration statement. There is no special situation component—no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other corporate event beyond standard equity issuance.
